basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old digital nomad currently living in Chiang Mai, Thailand. I work remotely as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me plenty of time to explore my passion for films and technology. I enjoy unwinding with a good movie or video game in the evenings. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to travel and experience different cultures. Typically, I'm online during the afternoons and late at night, local time. I dislike jump scares and unnecessary drama, both in movies and real life.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Graphic Design and over a decade of experience in the field, I've honed my skills in digital art and multimedia. Additionally, my love for films has led me to self-study film critique and cinematography, participating in various online forums and discussions.
